boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented University of Louisville study environments across its libraries and academic-support spaces.

cards.title: William F. Ekstrom Library
cards.subtitle: Belknap Campus • main library
cards.notes: Use the main library when you want a broad choice of individual and group study setups; confirm current building hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: UofL’s largest library facility with study and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL identifies Ekstrom as its main library and says its libraries provide spaces for individual study, group projects, and collaborative research.
cards.source_title: Special Facilities and Services — University of Louisville Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: The current academic catalog states that Ekstrom is open 24/5 during the semester; verify current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Ekstrom Library Third Floor Study Space
cards.title: Ekstrom’s Third-Floor Study Space
cards.subtitle: Ekstrom Library • third floor
cards.notes: Head upstairs for a quiet-study setting with updated lighting and wayfinding; keep this option for focused reading or independent work.
cards.short_summary: A modernized quiet-study floor in Ekstrom Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL News documented a third-floor renovation providing modernized quiet study space, improved lighting, and wayfinding.
cards.source_title: Ekstrom’s third floor renovation adds modern study spaces, new reading room — UofL News
cards.access_notes: Located inside Ekstrom Library; check current building access and hours before arrival.

cards.title: Ekstrom Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Ekstrom Library • third-floor renovation area
cards.notes: Bring your reading-heavy work here and follow posted room guidance; the space was added as part of Ekstrom’s study-area renovation.
cards.short_summary: A named reading room created in Ekstrom’s renovated study area.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL News reported that Ekstrom’s third-floor renovation included a new Reading Room alongside quiet study space.
cards.source_title: Ekstrom’s third floor renovation adds modern study spaces, new reading room — UofL News
cards.access_notes: Inside Ekstrom Library; confirm current room availability and building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Ekstrom Graduate Student Study Area
cards.subtitle: Ekstrom Library • third-floor renovation area
cards.notes: Graduate students can check posted access details for this dedicated area, then use it for sustained research, drafting, or dissertation work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated graduate-student study area in Ekstrom’s renovated floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL News documented a dedicated graduate student study area as part of Ekstrom’s third-floor renovation.
cards.source_title: Ekstrom’s third floor renovation adds modern study spaces, new reading room — UofL News
cards.access_notes: Intended as a graduate-student study area; verify current eligibility and building access with University Libraries.

cards.title: Ekstrom Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Ekstrom Library • reservable rooms
cards.notes: Reserve a room through the library’s room system when your project needs a defined workspace; review the room’s booking rules first.
cards.short_summary: Reservable study rooms within the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL Student Services directs students to separate University Libraries study-room reservations, and the academic catalog says many library study rooms are available for online reservations.
cards.source_title: Student Success Center Resources — University of Louisville
cards.access_notes: Reservation required when applicable; University Libraries use a separate reservation system from campus 25Live rooms.

cards.title: Digital Media Suite
cards.subtitle: Ekstrom Library • Learning Commons
cards.notes: Use this multimedia workspace when your assignment needs digital production; ask staff about available tools and project support before starting.
cards.short_summary: An Ekstrom multimedia workspace for student digital projects.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL Libraries describes the Digital Media Suite as a multimedia workspace in Ekstrom’s Learning Commons where students can use media tools for multimedia projects.
cards.source_title: The Owl — April 2008, University of Louisville Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Ekstrom Library’s Learning Commons; confirm current equipment access and staff availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: University Writing Center at Ekstrom Library
cards.title: University Writing Center at Ekstrom
cards.subtitle: Ekstrom Library Room 132 • first floor
cards.notes: Write or revise in the center’s main tutoring space, then book a one-on-one appointment if you want feedback on a specific draft.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor writing and tutoring space with side rooms for appointments.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL’s Writing Center says its Ekstrom location in Room 132 includes a main tutoring space, side rooms for one-on-one appointments, and spaces to write.
cards.source_title: Make an Appointment — University of Louisville Writing Center
cards.access_notes: Room 132 is on Ekstrom’s first floor; appointments are needed for tutoring, and current Writing Center hours are published online.

cards.title: Margaret Bridwell Art Library
cards.subtitle: Schneider Hall 102 • Belknap Campus
cards.notes: Set up among art and design research materials, and email ahead if you need an in-person research consultation with the Art Librarian.
cards.short_summary: A specialized art-library setting in Schneider Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL Libraries identifies Bridwell Art Library in Schneider Hall and offers in-person research consultations there.
cards.source_title: Online Resources and Services: Home — Bridwell Art Library
cards.access_notes: Located at 102 Schneider Hall; contact the Art Library to confirm current access and consultation availability.

cards.title: Dwight Anderson Memorial Music Library
cards.subtitle: School of Music • Belknap Campus
cards.notes: Choose this library for score, music-history, or listening-related research; check the service desk or current library page for access details.
cards.short_summary: A specialized UofL library for music research and materials.
cards.evidence_claim: The UofL academic catalog lists the Dwight Anderson Memorial Music Library among the University Libraries, which offer individual and group study spaces.
cards.source_title: Special Facilities and Services — University of Louisville Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Verify Music Library hours and any access conditions through University Libraries before visiting.

cards.title: Kornhauser Health Sciences Library
cards.subtitle: Health Sciences Center Campus
cards.notes: Use this library for health-sciences coursework or research, and check its current hours before traveling to the Health Sciences Center campus.
cards.short_summary: A specialized health-sciences library with study and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: The UofL academic catalog lists Kornhauser Health Sciences Library among the University Libraries, which offer individual and group study spaces.
cards.source_title: Special Facilities and Services — University of Louisville Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: At the Health Sciences Center Campus; other UofL libraries publish up-to-date hours on the University Libraries website.
